verified_current_contents: A source-led reconstruction workflow covering acquisition, scene inventory, typography, geometry, camera measurement and deterministic scene authoring.
Five rendering implementations under scripts/engines plus scripts/shared/scene-schema.json; method availability is treated as a render/capability question.
Verification, scope preservation, retained caches, coherent encoding, provenance, failure diagnosis and delivery procedures, with linked execution evidence.
A UI-audio workflow and bundled audio evidence/synthesis code; visual actions determine effects.
skill_audit.honest_current_description: The existing skill is primarily a measured recreation and verification production workflow with renderer infrastructure and evidence. It is not yet established as a ready-made visual director/component library.
not_demonstrated_yet: A generic editable component API implementing the five named recipes below.
A published recipe atlas or visual director interface with adjustable presets.
An arbitrary shape-morph example such as circle-to-square from either Photon reference.
Live font-text editing for every source-derived caption, wall card or UI interior.
skill_audit.recommended_upgrade_boundary: Expose Source Study (frozen measured choreography and provenance) separately from New Choreography (semantic editable components, director-authored timing/camera, supplied asset slots). Do not relabel dense reference correction data as generic presets.

audit_diagnosis: An attempted send-control frame179 example failed canonical ID validation. Inspecting root-send-flight-pose-179 showed only material and glyph children; there is no root-send-flight-control-179. Correct examples use actual controls175/177/178, with179 retained only as an atlas bubble-flight frame.
Legacy early-sent-message-flight has start=end and cannot render. group-1068 is a short half-frame interval containing no exact native sample in V19; actual orbit uses root-orbit-pose-N.

contract.pixel_space: 1920×1080 source pixels; numeric examples are local to their canonical hierarchy, asset dimensions, pivots and clips. Do not apply local numbers to a different asset without preserving those relationships.
contract.time: Both sources use 30 fps, zero-based native frames and identity source/output mapping. Ranges are inclusive; half-open seconds are also supplied.
contract.numeric_evidence: All numeric animation examples were extracted directly from the canonical JSON. Single-frame actors are discrete measured poses, not invented continuous curves. Non-integer authored key times remain non-integer; they are not claimed native sample frames.
contract.new_design_parameters: Proposed control names have no invented numeric defaults. A new director must author and test new values.
contract.atlas: Six current lossless GSAP frame picks per motif are supplied, with matching source indices and PNG hashes. No new atlas/media was rendered by this audit.
contract.interpretation: Director readings are interpretations of observed design, not claims about the original creators’ stated intentions.

measured_source_recreation.camera_structure: group-1118 carries a late root y exit, while much source scroll/zoom fitting lives in dense per-message x/y/scale tracks. group-1077 is a separate header transform. A clean reusable camera component would be an intentional refactor.
measured_source_recreation.editability_limit: Native bubble bodies/tails and semantic glyphs are separate; rich-card interiors, portraits, brand and glass materials can remain bounded original artwork. Glyph outlines are not live editable type.

visual_design_notes: A new message grows from the lower region before the thread advances; scroll frames do not create extra arrivals.
Keep context header and message stack on independent planes and preserve measured overlap/occlusion in source mode.
Use outgoing and incoming portrait actors simultaneously during crossfades; a single teleporting portrait cannot show both.
Rich-link birth grows/blur-resolves before the settled card.
The header and thread exit independently at 1028–1029 rather than leaving a frozen badge behind.

new_reusable_choreography.rule: Solve new semantic layout before camera movement and provide explicit director beats. New readability/occlusion choices are new choreography, not measured source facts.
